bullets.text: In Chennai, a 27-year-old man died and his colleague became critical from toxic fumes while clearing a septic tank in Pallikaranai.
In Ambattur, a younger brother stabbed his older brother to death following a dispute regarding harassment of his daughter and surrendered.
Near Gummidipoondi, a worker tragically died from asphyxiation after entering a chemical tanker for a wage of 1000 rupees.
The Tamil Nadu State Wetlands Authority reduced the interim buffer zone of the Pallikaranai Ramsar wetland to 316.76 acres across 36 survey numbers.
CUMTA proposed preparing detailed project reports for model mobility corridors along three key road stretches including Taramani Link Road.
The Velachery Residents Welfare Association hosted a thanksgiving lunch to honour the contribution of sanitation workers to neighbourhood cleanliness.
Heavy overnight rain lashed Gummidipoondi, causing severe waterlogging and flooding across local roads.
In Avadi, police arrested two friends who cheated victims of 6 crore rupees by offering fraudulent online trading training.
At Puzhal Central Prison in Chennai, authorities booked a lawyer and an inmate after discovering ganja concealed inside a pen refill.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay will inaugurate the CapitaLand mega data centre built in the Ambattur industrial estate.
A 69-year-old former Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology director lost 1.25 crore rupees to a digital arrest scam in Chennai.
Adani Enterprises and Jabil signed a pact to form a 50:50 joint venture for manufacturing AI and data centre hardware in India.
The DMK revived the BJP B-team charge against actor-turned-politician Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam by connecting his hand gesture to an RSS salute.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay inspected flood prevention and preparedness work at the Okkiyam Maduvu canal area in Sholinganallur.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay laid the foundation stone for the Rs 3,108.55 crore ring main pipeline project at Sholinganallur to improve drinking water distribution.
